    def component(sr,sc):

        candidates.append((others,len(seen),sr,sc,color,seen))
    # Enclosed seed has the smallest component; in one-seed cases it is trivial.
    candidates.sort(key=lambda x:(x[0],x[1]))
    *_,color,seen=candidates[0]
